title: UGM–Indosat–NVIDIA Discuss Strengthening Multimodal AI Research for Precision Agriculture, Continue Visit to Faculty of Agricultural Technology

body:
By: Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty

Yogyakarta, February 9, 2026 – Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) together with Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (IOH) and NVIDIA held a series of Tech Meeting activities as part of strengthening strategic collaboration in the development of artificial intelligence research and ecosystem. The activity took place over two days, February 9–10, 2026, held at the Innovation and Creativity Arena (GIK) UGM and several related faculties within UGM.

The series of activities began with a Coordination Meeting and Research Meeting involving three main research clusters of UGM, namely Multimodal AI for Smart Agriculture, Precision Medicine, and Disaster Technology. The discussion was led by the Head of UGM's Digital Transformation Bureau, Dr. Mardani Riasetiawan, M.T., and attended by representatives of university leadership, cross-faculty researchers, and delegations from NVIDIA AI Technology Center and Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-1-image-7-1030x619.webp)

During the Smart Agriculture research presentation session, the FTP UGM team represented by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, S.T.P., M.Sc., Ph.D, IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., and Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, S.T.P. introduced the initiative for developing Multimodal AI for Tropical Precision Agriculture, an integrated artificial intelligence system that combines drone data, greenhouse imagery, hyperspectral sensor data, and IoT microclimate data in a single platform based on NVIDIA edge–cloud. The system is designed to support plant stress detection, canopy analysis, disease identification, and integration of environmental conditions in real-time using NVIDIA Jetson, TAO Toolkit, TensorRT, and Metropolis technologies.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-2-image-8-1030x230.webp)

Subsequently, the activity continued with a visit to the candidate site for NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) Joint Center within the GIK UGM area, as part of planning for the joint research collaboration center. In this session, the NVIDIA and IOH teams reviewed the readiness of UGM's research infrastructure to support the implementation of edge AI systems and 5G–edge–cloud orchestration.

Entering the Laboratory Visit session, the delegation conducted visits to several faculties, including the Faculty of Agricultural Technology (FTP) UGM. At FTP, the visit was focused on laboratory facilities supporting precision agriculture research, particularly the Laboratory of Agricultural Energy and Machinery DTPB UGM. The FTP team presented the potential application of Multimodal AI in the context of tropical agriculture, ranging from drone-based plant monitoring, visual analysis in greenhouses, to integration of environmental sensors to support agronomic decision-making.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-3-image-9-1030x788.webp)

In the visit, DTPB FTP UGM researchers explained that collaboration with NVIDIA and IOH opens significant opportunities for developing more comprehensive data-based precision agriculture systems. Edge AI technology enables direct analysis in the field, while 5G connectivity supports real-time data transmission from agricultural sites to computation centers.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-4-image-10-1030x635.webp)

Through this series of Tech Meetings and laboratory visits, FTP UGM reaffirms its commitment to developing applicable Multimodal AI research with direct impact for the tropical agriculture sector. This collaboration is expected to serve as a foundation for developing smart farming based on cutting-edge technology, while strengthening UGM's role as a center for AI research innovation in Indonesia.

This activity also contributes to the achievement of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) through increased agricultural productivity, SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure) through strengthening research and technology, and SDG 17 (Partnerships to Achieve the Goals) through collaboration between higher education institutions and global technology industries.

original.body:
Oleh: Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty

Yogyakarta, 9 Februari 2026 – Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) bersama Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (IOH) dan NVIDIA menggelar rangkaian kegiatan Tech Meeting sebagai bagian dari penguatan kolaborasi strategis dalam pengembangan riset dan ekosistem kecerdasan artifisial. Kegiatan ini berlangsung selama dua hari, 9–10 Februari 2026, bertempat di Gelanggang Inovasi dan Kreativitas (GIK) UGM dan sejumlah fakultas terkait di lingkungan UGM.

Rangkaian kegiatan diawali dengan _Coordination Meeting_ dan _Research Meeting_ yang melibatkan tiga klaster riset utama UGM, yaitu Multimodal AI untuk _Smart Agriculture_, _Precision Medicine_, dan _Disaster Technology_. Diskusi dipimpin oleh Kepala Biro Transformasi Digital UGM, Dr. Mardani Riasetiawan, M.T., dan dihadiri oleh perwakilan pimpinan universitas, peneliti lintas fakultas, serta delegasi dari NVIDIA AI Technology Center dan Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-1-image-7-1030x619.webp)

Pada sesi pemaparan riset _Smart Agriculture_, tim FTP UGM yang diwakili oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, S.T.P., M.Sc., Ph.D, IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., dan Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, S.T.P. memperkenalkan inisiatif pengembangan _Multimodal AI for Tropical Precision Agriculture_, yaitu sistem kecerdasan artifisial terintegrasi yang mengombinasikan data _drone_, citra _greenhouse_, sensor hiperspektral, dan data IoT mikroklimat dalam satu platform berbasis NVIDIA _edge–cloud_. Sistem ini dirancang untuk mendukung deteksi stres tanaman, analisis kanopi, identifikasi penyakit, hingga integrasi kondisi lingkungan secara _real-time_ menggunakan teknologi NVIDIA Jetson, TAO Toolkit, TensorRT, dan Metropolis.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-2-image-8-1030x230.webp)

Selanjutnya, kegiatan dilanjutkan dengan kunjungan ke lokasi kandidat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) Joint Center di lingkungan GIK UGM, sebagai bagian dari perencanaan pusat kolaborasi riset bersama. Pada sesi ini, tim NVIDIA dan IOH meninjau kesiapan infrastruktur riset UGM untuk mendukung implementasi sistem edge AI dan 5G–edge–cloud orchestration.

Memasuki sesi _Laboratory Visit_, rombongan melakukan kunjungan ke beberapa fakultas, salah satunya Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian (FTP) UGM. Di FTP, kunjungan difokuskan pada fasilitas laboratorium yang mendukung riset pertanian presisi, khususnya Laboratorium Energi dan Mesin Pertanian DTPB UGM. Tim FTP memaparkan potensi penerapan Multimodal AI dalam konteks pertanian tropis, mulai dari pemantauan tanaman berbasis _drone_, analisis visual di _greenhouse_, hingga integrasi sensor lingkungan untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan agronomis.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-3-image-9-1030x788.webp)

Dalam kunjungan tersebut, peneliti DTPB FTP UGM menjelaskan bahwa kolaborasi dengan NVIDIA dan IOH membuka peluang besar untuk pengembangan sistem pertanian presisi berbasis data yang lebih komprehensif. Teknologi edge AI memungkinkan analisis langsung di lapangan, sementara konektivitas 5G mendukung transmisi data secara _real-time_ dari lokasi pertanian ke pusat komputasi.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/603-4-image-10-1030x635.webp)

Melalui rangkaian _Tech Meeting_ dan kunjungan laboratorium ini, FTP UGM menegaskan komitmennya dalam mengembangkan riset Multimodal AI yang aplikatif dan berdampak langsung bagi sektor pertanian tropis. Kolaborasi ini diharapkan menjadi fondasi bagi pengembangan _smart farming_ berbasis teknologi mutakhir, sekaligus memperkuat peran UGM sebagai pusat inovasi riset AI di Indonesia.

Kegiatan ini juga berkontribusi terhadap pencapaian Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), khususnya SDG 2 (Tanpa Kelaparan) melalui peningkatan produktivitas pertanian, SDG 9 (Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur) melalui penguatan riset dan teknologi, serta SDG 17 (Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan) melalui kolaborasi antara perguruan tinggi dan industri teknologi global.
